arms.C-BASE: unmodified ArchC, byte-identical config to EXP-FP-0010 C-STD (pomaze) and EXP-FP-C-BUILD-AND-BEAT C (rule envs). Reference.
arms.C-GAIN-LIFT: ArchC with LiftedFloorArbitrator (additive subclass): update_gains floors at gain_floor=0.5 instead of 0.01. All other update logic byte-identical to AttentionArbitrator.update_gains. 0.5 = half the 1.0 neutral initial gain.
arms.C-REPEAT-PENALTY: ArchC with RepeatPenaltyArbitrator (additive subclass of AttentionArbitrator / CueIndexedArbitrator). On arbitration: competed[c] <- competed[c] - PENALTY * wins_in_last_WINDOW(c), PENALTY=0.02, WINDOW=4. Winner = argmax of penalized bids (canonical channel-order tie-break). Penalty scale set from 0010 measurements: frozen-winner margins were 0.001-0.006, so 0.02 dominates a frozen margin but is small against genuine stimulus-driven bid swings.

consciousness: UNRESOLVED — closed-loop returns + telemetry only; no privileged-person machinery; this experiment makes no consciousness claim.

changing_rule.role: CONTROL: healthy task where C~=A (battery C mean 30.04 vs A 31.10)

compositional_rule.role: CONTROL (secondary): healthy task where C~=A (battery C mean 35.08 vs A 35.46)

frozen_gates.G0: additivity: canonical c_agent.py, attention.py, attention_cue.py, tick.py, pomaze.py, changing_rule.py, compositional_rule.py untouched (sha256 recorded pre-run); all new code in additive files only
frozen_gates.G1_attractor_break: intervention counts as breaking the attractor iff Delta_stuck >= 0.3 AND Delta_return >= 1.0 (both seed-averaged, paired seeds, canonical pomaze)
frozen_gates.G2_control: intervention counts as USABLE iff it is not destroyed on the healthy control: changing_rule seed-mean >= 0.7 * C-BASE seed-mean. Compositional_rule reported descriptively.
frozen_gates.G3: fabrication tripwire CLEAN on all new code (pre-run)
frozen_gates.G5: hash-chained ndjson receipt, verified; G6 nothing pushed

hypothesis: At least one of two independent attractor-breaking interventions breaks C's bump attractor on canonical pomaze. (a) ANTI-HABITUATION: an additive per-channel penalty proportional to recent wins in the competed bid breaks the self-reinforcing loop directly (targets the habituation-freeze half). (b) GAIN-FLOOR LIFT: raising the gain floor from 0.01 to 0.5 lets the predictor's stimulus variation reach selection (targets the integration-failure half).
limitations: 15 pomaze episodes/seed (same as 0010); interventions are fixed-parameter, no tuning allowed post-seal (PENALTY=0.02, WINDOW=4, gain_floor=0.5); repeat-penalty is a behavioral proxy for the habituation loop, not a direct bid-habituation change; pomaze-only primary test.
mechanism_under_test: EXP-FP-0010 measured: gains floored at 0.01 on 0.997 of channel-episodes -> arbitration = argmax of habituated raw bids -> raw bids respond only to stimulus CHANGES (RunningZScoreBid) -> a wall-bumping loop yields static obs -> static stimuli -> frozen winner -> self-reinforcing bump attractor (stuck 0.972, return -5.88 worse than random). Predictor stimulus variation (std ~0.97, stim_perp_beacon |r|=0.053) cannot reach action selection through the floored gain loop: an integration failure.

metrics.decision_metrics: seed-averaged over the 6 seeds: Delta_stuck = stuck(C-BASE) - stuck(intervention); Delta_return = return(intervention) - return(C-BASE)
per_seed_per_arm: mean_return (mean over episodes of total return)
mean_stuck_frac (pomaze only: ticks with no position change / ticks)
gain_floor_frac (pomaze only: channel-episodes with gain <= 0.011 at episode end, C-BASE only meaningful)

null: C stays stuck: neither intervention reduces stuck-fraction by >=0.3 with return improving by >=1.0 (the attractor is not the mechanism, or is not breakable this way).
pairing: paired across arms: identical env seed streams and identical agent-seed derivation per primary seed; one persistent agent instance per (arm, seed) across episodes within an env (0010/battery convention).
question: Does breaking arch-C's wall-bump attractor (EXP-FP-0010 mechanism) require the self-reinforcing habituation loop, the floored gain loop, or neither? Causal test of the 0010 bump-attractor mechanism.

verdict_mapping.ATTRACTOR_BROKEN_USABLE: >=1 intervention fires G1 and passes G2 -> 0010 mechanism confirmed causally; the intervention is a candidate repair of the C integration failure
verdict_mapping.BROKEN_BUT_DESTRUCTIVE: G1 fires but G2 fails -> the loop IS the mechanism (causal confirmation), but this intervention is not a usable repair (trades the attractor for destroyed healthy performance)
verdict_mapping.NULL_HOLDS: no intervention fires G1 -> record as negative result (research/negative_results.md); the attractor is not breakable this way, or the 0010 mechanism is wrong
